extra.summary: The HSBC TravelOne Credit Card is tailored for travelers, offering a range of benefits to enhance their journeys. Cardholders can earn miles on their spending, with accelerated points for travel-related expenses, and redeem them for various rewards including airline miles and hotel stays. Additionally, the card provides complimentary airport lounge access through Priority Pass™ and travel insurance coverage.
badges: Earn up to 2.4 Miles | Instant Activation*

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Interest Rate: Effective Rate: 26.9% p.a. (minimum), Minimum Charge: S$2.50
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Fee Waiver: For the second year onwards, we'll waive the Annual Fee for your card if you spend more than S$25,000 per year (No fee waiver for the first year.)
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: 100% of the monthly instalment plan amount and interest/fees, 1% of remaining outstanding balances, excess amount above your credit limit (if your account is overlimit) or $50 (in the currency of your account), whichever is greater

minimum-income-requirements.Singaporean/PR Minimum Annual Income:
(a) Singaporeans, Singapore Permanent Residents: SGD 65,000 OR 
 (b) Singapore Citizens / Permanent Residents with HSBC total relationship balance (“TRB”)* of at least SGD50,000: SGD 30,000 for salaried employees 
 SGD 40,000 for self-employed or commission-based (*Total Relationship Balance (TRB) refers to the total value of your deposits, investments, and insurance with HSBC Bank (Singapore) Limited, calculated based on the average monthly balance over the last 3 months.)

our_takes.our-take: The HSBC TravelOne Card is tailored for frequent travellers seeking flexibility in miles redemption. Its instant rewards redemption via the HSBC app offers convenience, while accelerated earn rates enhance value. Given the annual fee, aim for the S$25,000 annual spend waiver to maximize cost-efficiency. Complimentary travel insurance and lounge access add tangible value for overseas trips including coverage for COVID-19. However, those prioritizing cashback over miles or seeking simple, uncapped rewards may find other cards more suitable. The 3.25% foreign transaction fee warrants consideration for international spending.
our_takes.good-for:
Frequent travelers seeking accelerated miles, instant reward redemption, and complimentary travel insurance for peace of mind.
Cardholders looking for travel perks such as lounge access and ENTERTAINER deals to enhance their trips.
Those who value flexibility in managing purchases with options for instalment plans that suit various financial needs.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Watch out for the 26.9% p.a. interest; carrying a balance will incur substantial costs. Aim to pay in full each month.
The 3.25% foreign transaction fee applies; for overseas spending, explore cards with lower or no fees.
The S$100 late payment fee adds up; set reminders to pay by the due date to avoid extra charges.
